Cleveland Aquatic Center

Address
8120 Vanalden Ave., Reseda, CA 91335
Area
Valley
Phone
(818) 756-9798
Email
Cleveland.Pool@lacity.org
Facility
Year Round 25 yard Pool, Pool heated to 80°F; Therapeutic Pool: 13 yd. shallow pool heated to 89 degrees. Call for availability.
Programs
Swim Lessons, Synchronized Swimming, Water Polo, Dive Team, Aquatics Fitness, Lifeguards, Swim Team (also: Parent & Child lessons 6 mo–3 yr; private/semi-private Tue & Thu)
